statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-116587 is a denial of service from crafted RSA parameters in a parsed JWK in go-jose v3, which has no fixed release (fixed in v4 4.1.6 only). In openbao 2.7.2 the recipe floors hashicorp/cap to v0.15.0, which moves the JWT auth method to go-jose v4; the build then fails if any package other than github.com/okta/okta-sdk-golang/v2 imports v3 (go list -deps check in melange.yaml). Okta SDK v2.20.0 uses go-jose only to sign: okta/requestExecutor.go:237-261 (CreateKeySigner, CreateClientAssertion) builds a jose.Signer for private-key client auth; it never parses a JWK, decrypts a JWE or parses a JOSE object, which is where all three flaws live. openbao builds its Okta client with okta.WithToken (internal/vault/login_mfa.go:1219, SSWS API token), so even the signer is not called. Checked on 2026-11-11 against the 2.7.2 source and the v2.20.0 module.
